Climb the volcano path in Skartara
Climb the volcano path in Skartara
The old Horadric Vault on Skartara is the only place we might reforge the Blade. I must brave the mountain with Lorath and Tyrael.
Our path has crumbled into the lava below. We must find another way, perhaps west of here; I think I see an opening in the rock.
Travel to the First Vault in Skartara with Tyrael and Lorath
Find the tunnel entrance
Both Tyrael and Lorath believe this is the only way to reforge the Blade. But the mountain path is long and winding, and the ground trembles beneath us. It will take all our wits to survive.
